items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Well the time I was playing with Celestan, they had a trumpet. We had Andrew Anderson, Dave Bartholomew, and probably Celestan.

ctx.x: Some day we'll make a copy of that. I should have brought our camera today. Today, I just got back from a trip upstate and up to, over to Texas and all last night, so I didn't get things organized quite for today.
And I have a picture of when I was with Dave Bartholomew. I have a picture up in the book up there. Of the whole band?
